lifecycle.story: Bonnie bought the rowhouse with a mortgage from Testtown Savings & Loan. The lien is active: title cannot transfer until the bank cosigns a lien-release into the asset's vault. The payoff amount, rate, and payment history are private vault records — a buyer learns only the single bit 'encumbered'.
kernelExpectations: 'is this property lien-free?' answers false in one bit — owner, lender, and balance not revealed
the transfer circuit halts at the encumbrance check: no escrow credential issues while the lien stands
lien release is a cosigned ceremony — the lender's release attestation must come from a TIR-approved financial issuer, not from the owner
after release the encumbrance record stays in the vault as provenance (released), preserving the VIN invariant: records never move, access rotates
